description:
🌟 About Specs London

Specs London is a British-owned eyewear brand, founded in 2024, with a mission to “redefine everyday luxury.” 


We bring together over 25 years of experience in the fashion and eyewear world to fill a gap: high-quality, stylish eyewear that balances timeless design, premium quality, and affordability — without the “luxury markup.” 


Our collection includes carefully edited frames designed to be worn and loved every day — from sunglasses to optical and blue-light glasses — blending classic silhouettes with modern sensibility. 


At its core, Specs London is “effortless, sophisticated, uncompromising.” 


✅ What Makes Us Different

  • Everyday luxury at accessible prices — We aim to give customers premium-feeling eyewear without a heavy price tag. 

  • Timeless & thoughtful design — Our frames are rooted in classic shapes, refined by a modern lens: season-less pieces that don’t chase fleeting trends but are built to remain stylish over time. 

  • Quality paired with practicality — Our eyewear offers more than just looks: sunglasses provide 100% UVA/UVB protection, and many optical frames include blue-light protection. 

  • Inclusive and versatile collection — We offer a range of sunglasses and optical eyewear in women’s and unisex styles. 

  • Customer-first approach — With features like virtual try-on for frames, clear return/exchange policies and international shipping, our shopping experience is designed to make buying glasses online simple and confidence-inspiring.


💡 How Affiliates Can Earn

As an affiliate of Specs London, you earn commissions by referring customers who purchase our eyewear through your link. Here’s how it works:

  • You share your unique affiliate link or code with your audience (social media, blog, newsletter, etc.).

  • When someone clicks your link and purchases from the Specs London site, you earn a commission on the sale (after any returns/cancellations are resolved).

  • Commissions are tracked and paid out once per month (for the previous month’s approved sales). 

  • Because our products combine style, quality, and accessibility, they appeal broadly — which helps convert referrals into actual sales.


📣 How to Promote Specs London (Affiliate Tips)

Here are some effective ways to promote Specs London and maximise your affiliate earnings:

  • Showcase real-life styling — Pair our frames with everyday outfits (casual, workwear, night-out) to show how versatile and timeless they are.

  • Emphasise value + quality — Stress that Specs London offers “everyday luxury” — premium look and feel, UV protection or blue-light glasses, at an accessible price point.

  • Use visuals and try-on features — Encourage audiences to use the site’s virtual try-on to see how frames look on them; it builds confidence especially when buying online.

  • Create content around eyewear needs — Think blog posts or social posts on: “Glass styles for office life (blue-light)”, “Best sunglasses for London winters”, “Affordable luxury eyewear under £60”, etc.

  • Leverage multiple channels — Use social media (Instagram, TikTok), blog posts, newsletters or video content to showcase frames; eyewear works well visually.

  • Highlight inclusivity and ease — Mention that Specs London ships internationally, offers returns or exchanges (14-day return window), making it low-risk for new buyers.


ℹ️ Other Useful Information / FAQs

  • We offer sunglasses, optical frames, blue-light protection eyewear, and unisex styles. 

  • All sunglasses feature 100% UVA and UVB protection.

  • We don’t provide prescription lenses directly (yet) — but buyers can take our frames to a certified optician to get prescription lenses fitted. 

  • Shipping is available internationally; UK standard shipping usually takes 2–4 business days.

  • Returns or exchanges are allowed within 14 days if the customer changes their mind. 

  • We sometimes offer sale frames and occasional discounts — this can be a good angle for affiliate promotions to drive conversions.
